[`NSPersistentDocument`](nspersistentdocument.md) does not support the asynchronous saving API of [`NSDocument`](nsdocument.md) because that API requires accessing the document’s state on multiple threads and that violates the requirements of the [`NSManagedObjectContext`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreData/NSManagedObjectContext) class.
